decisions.reason: Core distributed lighting control solution with an established standard-setting position, so the option remains highly valuable and low-risk to keep.
Air situation display has had time to prove itself and likely complements our surveillance options, so the option is still worth holding.
Low-cost training program that supports our systems and can be maintained with little investment, so we keep the option open.
Airfield lighting training course is closely tied to our core lighting business and inexpensive to maintain, making it a low-risk option.
Airport collaboration software is peripheral to our core electrical equipment business and requires ongoing software investment with limited evidence of adoption, so we abandon this option.
Advanced multilateration system is a strategic high-uncertainty option that could open the surveillance market, so we keep it open despite the costs.
